title: 2021年12月四级真题 第3套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 From climate change to the ongoing pandemic(大流行病) and beyond, the issues facing today's world are increasingly complex and dynamic. Yet solving problems like these requires new approaches that extend beyond traditional ways of thinking. A study led by Yale Professor of Psychology, Paul O'Keefe, found that having a growth mindset(思维倾向) of interest may spark this type of innovation.

P2 Professor O'Keefe established in earlier studies that people hold different beliefs about the nature of interest. Those with a growth mindset of interest tend to believe that interests can be developed and cultivated, while those with a fixed mindset of interest tend to believe that interests are inherent(与生俱有的) and simply need to be 'found.' Building on these findings, the latest research examined how a growth mindset of interest can boost integrative thinking across the traditional disciplinary boundaries of arts and sciences.

P3 For example, in one task, research participants were instructed to create new college majors by combining two or more existing academic Arts or Science programs at their university. After coding and analyzing the ideas they generated, the team found that people with a growth mindset of interest were more likely to bridge programs across the arts and sciences to create new majors like computational economics rather than creating majors that drew from only one of those areas, like computational chemistry.

P4 As Professor O'Keefe pointed out, "This research provides a useful direction for organizations whose products and services call for integrated and creative solutions. Take smartphones for example. You need not only computer science and engineering knowledge, but also an understanding of psychology and visual design to create a better product. Employees with a growth mindset may be more likely to devise innovative ideas that bridge multiple areas of knowledge to achieve better solutions."

P5 The benefits of a growth mindset of interest may also extend to those seeking employment. This is a pressing issue because many people are becoming unemployed due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Having a growth mindset of interest can help job seekers expand their interests and become more adaptable to different fields, and take the initiative to learn new skills.

questions.q: What does the author say about the world today?
options: It faces problems that are getting more varied and complicated.
It has done away with many of the traditional ways of thinking.
It is undergoing radical and profound changes.
It is witnessing various types of innovations.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say about the world today? 用 What does ... say about ... 直接 问对象的属性，没有 infer/suggest/imply 这类推断信号。 51. What does the author say about the world today? A) It faces problems that are getting more varied and complicated. B) It has done away with many of the traditional ways of thinking. C) It is undergoing radical and profound changes. D) It is witnessing various types of innovations.

【拆句】What does the author say about the world today? 是 What 引导的特殊疑问句，主干 the author say，介词短语 about the world today 限定 say 的内容；结构平铺直叙，无 陷阱。

【定位】From climate change to the ongoing pandemic and beyond, the issues facing today's world are increasingly complex and dynamic. 从气候变化到当下这场大流行病再到更远的将来，当今世界面临的问题愈发复杂多变。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 complex and dynamic ↔varied and complicated are increasingly ↔are getting more the issues facing today's world ↔It faces problems It faces problems that are getting more varied and complicated 把定位句的主语、 谓语、表语三处都做了同义替换，没增没减，符合「正确项=定位句同义替换」的范式。 B) 偷换概念 requires new approaches that extend beyond traditional ways of thinking 只是说 「需要超越传统思路」，并未说「已经摒弃了传统思路」，把 require beyond 偷换为 done away with。 C) 过度推断 原文只说 issues 变得 complex and dynamic，并没有说世界「正在经历根本性、深刻 变化」这种更强的程度判断。 D) 偷换概念 原文 may spark this type of innovation 只是说成长型思维可能「催生」创新，并未说 世界「正在见证各种创新」；选项把对未来潜能的描述偷换为对当下现象的事实陈述。 O'Keefe教授在他早期的研究中发现了什么? A) 人们的兴趣往往随年龄而变化。 B) 人们的兴趣决定了他们的思维模式。 C) 人们对兴趣的本质存在分歧。 D) 不同年龄的人有不同的思维模式。

questions.q: What did Professor O'Keefe find in his earlier studies?
options: People's interests tend to change with age.
People's interests determine their mindsets.
People are divided about the nature of interest.
People of different ages have different mindsets.
questions.explain:
【判型】What did Professor O'Keefe find in his earlier studies? 直问「发现了什么」，要的是原 文已陈述的事实，不是推断。

【拆句】What did Professor O'Keefe find in his earlier studies? 是 What 引导的疑问句，主 语 Professor O'Keefe，谓语 find，介词短语 in his earlier studies 锁定时间范围；结构 清晰。 52. What did Professor O'Keefe find in his earlier studies? A) People's interests tend to change with age. B) People's interests determine their mindsets. C) People are divided about the nature of interest. D) People of different ages have different mindsets.

【定位】Professor O'Keefe established in earlier studies that people hold different beliefs about the nature of interest. 奥基夫教授在早期研究中确立：人们对「兴趣的本质」持有不同的看法。

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文谈的是不同人对兴趣本质的不同看法，没有任何句子涉及「兴趣随年龄变化」这一 时间维度。 B) 与原文相反 原文 Those with a growth mindset of interest tend to believe that interests can be developed 是先有 mindset、再决定对 interest 的看法；选项却说 interests determine mindsets，主从颠倒。 C) ✓ 正确 hold different beliefs ↔are divided about the nature of interest ↔about the nature of interest people ↔People People are divided about the nature of interest 与定位句结构几乎一一对应，只把 hold different beliefs 改写为 are divided，正是「正确项=定位句同义替换」的范式。 D) 无中生有 原文区分人群依据是「思维倾向」（growth vs fixed），与年龄毫无关系；选项凭空引 入 ages 维度。 O'Keefe教授最近研究的重点是什么? A) 如何消除文科和理科学科之间的界限。 B) 创建计算经济学等新学科的可行性有多大。 C) 文科和理科学生如何看待这两种兴趣思维模式。 D) 兴趣的成长型思维模式如何有助于跨学科思维。

questions.q: What is the focus of Professor O'Keefe's recent research?
options: How boundaries can be removed between arts and science disciplines.
How feasible it is to create new disciplines like computational economics.
How students in arts and sciences view the two types of mindset of interest.
How a growth mindset of interest can contribute to cross-disciplinary thinking.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the focus of Professor O'Keefe's recent research? 直问焦点，对应原文的目的 句，仍属定位题而非推断题。

【拆句】What is the focus of Professor O'Keefe's recent research? 是 What 引导的疑问句， 主干 the focus is what，of 短语层层修饰：of ... recent research 限定焦点的归属；结构 清晰。

【定位】Building on these findings, the latest research examined how a growth mindset of interest can boost integrative thinking across the traditional disciplinary boundaries of arts and sciences. 在前述发现的基础上，最新研究考察了「兴趣的成长型思维倾向」如何促进跨越文理传统学 科边界的整合性思维。 53. What is the focus of Professor O'Keefe's recent research? A) How boundaries can be removed between arts and science disciplines. B) How feasible it is to create new disciplines like computational economics. C) How students in arts and sciences view the two types of mindset of interest. D) How a growth mindset of interest can contribute to cross-disciplinary thinking.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文是研究「成长型思维如何促进跨学科思维」，并不是研究「学科边界如何被去 除」；boundaries 一词被借用，但研究对象偷换。 B) 偷换概念 原文只是用 computational economics 一词举例佐证研究结论，并未把「创建这种新 学科是否可行」当作研究焦点。 C) 偷换概念 研究的是成长型思维对跨学科思维的促进作用，不是「文理学生如何看待两种思维」； 主体与对象都被偷换。 D) ✓ 正确 a growth mindset of interest can boost ↔a growth mindset of interest can contribute to integrative thinking across the traditional disciplinary boundaries ↔ cross-disciplinary thinking how ... can boost ↔How ... can contribute to How a growth mindset of interest can contribute to cross-disciplinary thinking 把 boost 换成 contribute to、把 integrative ... across boundaries 浓缩为 cross- disciplinary thinking，主语与从句结构原样保留。 作者想用智能手机的例子说明什么? A) 跨学科研究需要高科技产品。 B) 改进的技术催生了广受欢迎的产品。 C) 制造创新产品需要多学科知识。 D) 高科技产品可以促进人们的综合思维。

questions.q: What does the author want to illustrate with the example of smartphones?
options: Hi-tech products are needed in interdisciplinary research.
Improved technology gives birth to highly popular products.
Making innovative products needs multidisciplinary knowledge.
Hi-tech products can boost people's integrative thinking.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author want to illustrate with the example of smartphones? 同时出现 example 与 illustrate，明牌例证目的题。

【拆句】What does the author want to illustrate with the example of smartphones? What 疑 问句，谓语 want to illustrate（不定式作宾语），with 短语 with the example of smartphones 指明所用的例子；结构清晰。

【定位】Take smartphones for example. You need not only computer science and engineering knowledge, but also an understanding of psychology and visual design to create a better product. 以智能手机为例：你不仅需要计算机科学与工程学的知识，还需要心理学与视觉设计方面的 理解，才能造出更好的产品。 54. What does the author want to illustrate with the example of smartphones? A) Hi-tech products are needed in interdisciplinary research. B) Improved technology gives birth to highly popular products. C) Making innovative products needs multidisciplinary knowledge. D) Hi-tech products can boost people's integrative thinking.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文是举智能手机说明「制造好产品需要多学科」，不是说「跨学科研究需要高科技产 品」；主客体倒置。 B) 偷换概念 原文重点在「需要多种知识」，不在「技术进步催生了热门产品」；选项偷换了论证 目的。 C) ✓ 正确 not only computer science and engineering knowledge, but also an understanding of psychology and visual design ↔multidisciplinary knowledge to create a better product ↔Making innovative products You need ↔needs Making innovative products needs multidisciplinary knowledge 把例子里四类知识 整体收束为 multidisciplinary knowledge，把 to create a better product 转写为主语 Making innovative products，整句保留 need 关系。 D) 与原文相反 原文是「需要整合思维 → 造出好产品」，选项却说「高科技产品 → 推动整合思维」， 把例子的目的反过来当因。 作者对求职者有什么建议? A) 学习实用技能。 B) 拓宽他们的兴趣。 C) 在疫情中保持安全。 D) 了解他们的紧迫问题。

questions.q: What is the author's suggestion to those who are seeking employment?
options: Learning practical skills.
Broadening their interests.
Staying safe in the pandemic.
Knowing their pressing issues.
questions.explain:
【判型】What is the author's suggestion to those who are seeking employment? 直问作者的 建议是什么，对应原文具体语句，不是宏观主旨。

【拆句】What is the author's suggestion to those who are seeking employment? What 疑问 句，主干 the author's suggestion is what；to those 是介宾短语，who are seeking employment 是限定 those 的定语从句；结构清晰。

【定位】Having a growth mindset of interest can help job seekers expand their interests and become more adaptable to different fields, and take the initiative to learn new skills. 拥有兴趣的成长型思维，能帮助求职者拓展兴趣、对不同领域更具适应力，并主动学习新 技能。 55. What is the author's suggestion to those who are seeking employment? A) Learning practical skills. B) Broadening their interests. C) Staying safe in the pandemic. D) Knowing their pressing issues.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 原文 take the initiative to learn new skills 强调「主动学新技能」，重心在 take the initiative；选项掐头去尾只留 learning skills 还加上原文没有的 practical 限定词。 B) ✓ 正确 expand their interests ↔Broadening their interests their interests ↔their interests Broadening their interests 只是把 expand their interests 改写为 Broadening their interests 的动名词形式，与原文建议三件事中的第一件完全对应；选项虽只覆盖三件事 中的一件，但其他选项无一对得上，B 仍是唯一合规答案。 C) 无中生有 原文只把疫情列为背景说明就业压力大，从未给出「在疫情中保持安全」这条建议；属 于借背景词造选项。 D) 偷换概念 This is a pressing issue 是作者用来说明问题紧迫性的描述，不是给求职者的建议；选 项把背景描述偷换成建议对象。
